label: Trivulzio monument

claims.statement: Windsor sheets for the project include RCIN 912356 (recto: base and sarcophagus vaguely indicated, horse and rider lower right; red chalk, pen and ink, 21.7 x 16.9 cm), and RCIN 912353, 912355, 912359, 912360 (titles only seen).

value.text: Bronze horse and rider on marble architecture with sarcophagus and captives

claims.statement: The design as described by RCT: a bronze horse and rider on a marble architectural framework housing Trivulzio's sarcophagus, flanked by tethered captives.
